Limits the overall number of attempts that can be made within the raid to 10. An attempt is failed if every member of the party dies during a challenge.

Sets a 40 minute time limit on the raid. If the time is achieved, the raid level is increased. Otherwise, the raid level is decreased.
Sets a 35 minute time limit on the raid. If the time is achieved, the raid level is increased. Otherwise, the raid level is decreased.
Sets a 30 minute time limit on the raid. If the time is achieved, the raid level is increased. Otherwise, the raid level is decreased.
Sets a 25 minute time limit on the raid. If the time is achieved, the raid level is increased. Otherwise, the raid level is decreased.

The quantity of items offered by the helpful spirit will be reduced to 33%.
The quantity of items offered by the helpful spirit will be reduced to 10%.
Completing a path during the raid will cause other paths to level up, increasing enemy hitpoints and damage. For every two path levels, bosses will gain more potent special attacks.
All paths will level up once upon entering the raid, increasing enemy hitpoints and damage.
All paths will level up twice upon entering the raid, increasing enemy hitpoints and damage further. Bosses will gain more potent special attacks.
All paths will level up three times upon entering the raid, increasing enemy hitpoints and damage even further. Bosses will gain more potent special attacks.
Protection prayers will be 10% less effective within the raid.
Prayer is drained by 20% of damage taken.
Food and other healing items will no longer heal you within the raid (with the exception of potions that restore health).
Potions that restore health will no longer have an effect within the raid.
All special attacks use 100% of your special attack energy.
Kephri will double the number of eggs containing an Agile Scarab during her egg attack.
During healing phases, Kephri will summon an additional scarab.
Kephri's dung special will be twice as potent.
Kephri will have continuous shield scarab spawns.
Kephri's main attack will do significantly more damage and hit a larger area.
Zebak will gain access to blood magic, casting Blood barrage and summoning blood clouds, healing Zebak when they damage players.
The radius and healing of Zebak's blood magic will be increased.
Zebak's blood magic spawns will be split into three and their health is increased.
Zebak's acid pools will have increased spread and jugs will be less effective.
Akkha will do two special attacks at once.
Akkha's ranged and magic attacks will also do melee damage to anyone next to him.
Akkha will randomly swap between attack styles and protection prayers rather than at set intervals.
Akkha's detonate special attack will trigger in more directions, his memory special attack will be faster and his trail special attack will spawn additional orbs.
The pit at the entrance to Ba-Ba's room will be a lethal fall.
Ba-Ba's sarcophagus energy will deal bonus damage based on how many prayer points you're missing.
Ba-Ba's baboons will drop banana peels on the floor on death.
The shockwave from Ba-Ba's slam will damage a wider area.
Ba-Ba's rolling boulders will spawn faster.
The Wardens will charge at a faster rate in the first phase of the fight.
The Wardens will attack quicker and the obelisk will charge at a faster rate in the second phase of the fight.
The Wardens obelisk attacks will be significantly more potent in the second phase of the fight.
The Wardens will attack faster in the final phase of the fight. Can be stacked with Overclocked 2.
The Wardens will attack faster in the final phase of the fight. Can be stacked with Overclocked.
The Wardens will become unstoppable. Floor slams are more frequent, phantoms attack faster, and tiles are removed more frequently during their final phase.
